images.filename: Naganatheshvara Temple (9th century) at Begur, Bengaluru.JPG
images.caption: This photograph was taken by me at the Naganatheshvara (or Naganatheshwara) temple in Begur, a suburb of Bengaluru city (Bangalore) in Karnataka state, India. The complex contains multiple shrines and these show architectural features of the Western Ganga Dynasty of Talakad and later additions by the Chola Dynasty.
images.alt: This photograph was taken by me at the Naganatheshvara (or Naganatheshwara) temple in Begur, a suburb of Bengaluru city (Bangalore) in Karnataka state, India. The complex contains multiple shrines and these show architectural features of the Western Ganga Dynasty of Talakad and later additions by the Chola Dynasty.
